31. (Currently amended) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, __and wherein the first balloon and the second balloon are configured to be independently inflated through separate lumens of the conduit__.

32. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises a first lumen in fluid communication with the first balloon, a second lumen in fluid communication with the second balloon, and a third lumen defining the instrument throughput channel, __wherein the first lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the first balloon independently of the second lumen, and the second lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the second balloon independently of the first lumen__.

33. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit has an axial length, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along the axial length, __from a proximal end of the conduit to a distal end of the conduit__.

34. (Cancelled)

35. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein [[in]] the first and second balloons are made from at least one of the following: silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, and nylon, __and wherein the first balloon and the second balloon are made from different materials selected from said following__.

36. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about [[10-40]] __greater than 10 and up to about 40__ mm.

41. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31, further comprising a delivery catheter configured to deliver the gastric space filler to the gastric cavity via an esophagus of the patient, wherein the delivery catheter is configured to receive the gastric space filler in a collapsed state, __and wherein the delivery catheter is configured to pass an instrument through the instrument throughput channel while the gastric space filler is received in the collapsed state__.

42. (Currently amended) A gastric space filler system, comprising: a conduit having a first end and a second end opposite the first end, wherein the first end is operably coupled to a first balloon and the second end is operably coupled to a second balloon; a first lumen through the conduit, wherein the lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the first balloon; a second lumen through the conduit, wherein the second lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the second balloon; and a third lumen extending through the conduit, wherein the third lumen is configured for instrument throughput, __the third lumen extending from the first end to the second end of the conduit and being separate from the first and second lumens__.

43. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein: the first lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the first balloon; and the second lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the second balloon, __wherein the first lumen and the second lumen are separately operable to independently inflate the first balloon and the second balloon__.

44. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the third lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to a second end of the conduit, __along substantially an entire axial length of the conduit__.

45. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42, further comprising a coupling mechanism at the first end of the conduit, wherein the coupling mechanism is configured for instrument throughput into the third lumen and configured to couple to a delivery catheter and/or a filling tube, __such that the instrument can be passed from the delivery catheter through the coupling mechanism into the third lumen__.

46. (Previously presented) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the gastric space filler system is configured for delivery through an esophagus of a patient to a stomach of the patient.

47. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the conduit is configured for attachment to a delivery catheter, and wherein the third lumen of the conduit is configured to receive an instrument passed through the delivery catheter, __the instrument being passable through the third lumen from the first end to the second end of the conduit__.
